assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## Reasoning

OpenCode 2.x runs a `task` tool call as a CHILD session: a session_v2 row whose parent_id is the caller. The 2.x reader selects parent_id (watcher_v2.go v2SessionsQuery), carries it as ParentSessionID on the child's new-session event, and the detector records parent_linked (session_detector_activity.go). P2's QA run linked a child on the sandbox service (pr2113-p2-subagent). The child is admitted on its own activity and binds to the same service pid. The parent's turn is blocked on its open `task` tool until the child reports back, so the parent's own turn end — its Stop hook — lands after the child finishes.

## Spec choices

- Parent birth, pid, working; a NEW ses_… transcript_new for the child, then parent_linked naming the parent.
- The child ends in ready; the parent's Stop hook and its ready come after the child's ready (relative_to the child's end).
- Generous bounds: the local model is slow to call the tool.
caveats: The local model must actually call the `task` tool; a run where it answers directly records no child and is not promoted.
2.x children are exempt from the ready-TTL and same-pid sweeps (pid_manager reapStaleChild/cleanupChildren skip `?session=` paths); they end with their parent or the service pid.

sources.note: 2.x reader: lists session_v2 rows with time_archived IS NULL; a session is admitted on its first session_message activity while a service is up (#2107); an archived or missing row emits EventRemoved (v2SessionGone)
servicePIDFor: a session no client runs binds to the one running service; OwnsSharedPID answers false for an archived row
2.x hook receiver: permission.asked holds waiting, session.execution.{succeeded,failed,interrupted} end the turn through HandleStopHook (#2108)
parent_linked is recorded from the child's ParentSessionID
P2 QA run: a task-tool child session linked on the sandbox service

preconditions: One OpenCode 2.x `serve --service` running, with a model it can reach (this host: the sandbox service, local Kolibri-1 4-bit model (mlx_lm) at 127.0.0.1:8087); the rig never starts, stops or reconfigures it
The three XDG exports, coexist IRRLICHT_ONBOARD_HOME and a non-7837 bind address from replaydata/agents/opencode-v2/prerequisites.md; OPENCODE_DB unset
setup: driver-interactive.sh (API driver) refuses before creating anything unless exactly one `serve --service` runs, its environment carries the run's XDG_* values, and the plugin's beacon resolves this run's daemon

It creates one session over POST /api/session at <staging>/cwd, waits for the service log to show the plugin the daemon installed loading for that location with no load failure, then drives the script; the session's session_message rows are exported read-only as the transcript
seed_instruction writes a README.md with one H1 heading into RUN_CWD before the session exists, so the child has a tiny, deterministic file to read (V1's 3-1 seeds the same)
One prompt that makes the model call the task tool with the built-in explore agent, wait for the parent's idle, then 8s
settings deny the shell tool in RUN_CWD/opencode.json (a backstop: the local model reached for it in a no-tool turn once)

script.text:
# Lighthouse Keeper's Log

A tiny project used by the onboarding rig.

Use the task tool to launch a subagent (the built-in 'explore' agent) that reads the README.md file in the current directory and reports its first heading. Wait for that subagent to finish, then reply with exactly the word: done.

verify: a child ses_… session appears and is parent_linked to the parent
the parent's Stop hook and ready land after the child's ready
